title: Psionics team at work on the night of the eight-gon recovery

tellings.quote: And there was a psionics team working that night.

plain: On a night in 2014 in the California desert, when an eight-sided craft was being recovered, a psionics team was also at work. Psionics means using the mind to sense or affect things at a distance. This comes from a helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, who says he took part in the recovery himself and tells Michels plainly that "there was a psionics team working that night", which, if true, would mean mind-based methods were part of how such craft are brought in.
